messages:
Maya (CS): Heads-up — ZenMesh onboarding showing repeated p95 spikes around 2.2-2.4s during EU business hours. Renewals flagged them as medium risk if we don’t show latency wins. Traffic is short-query heavy (~65% <=50 prompt tokens) but with a non-trivial tail of longer generation jobs. I propose a three-tier routing: short -> compact-lite-int4, mid -> compact-v2-int8, long -> base-v3-fp16 + enable prefix KV cache for session flows. Thoughts? cc @Kai @Omar

Omar (Solutions): Makes sense conceptually. Two asks: 1) run a focused eval on their top 4 endpoints (chat-summary, classify, faq, codegen) — int4 might regress on codegen or classification; 2) capture a simple explainer paragraph for the PM (risk/benefit + expected cost delta).

Kai (Eng-runtime): I can run a targeted A/B using 8k recent requests with session affinity preserved. Quick synthetic micro-run (2k):
A/B preview:
- baseline (base-v3-fp16): p95 = 2280ms, p50 = 310ms, avg_cost = 1.00x, quality_regressions = 0.6% (eval set)
- compact-v2-int8: p95 = 760ms, p50 = 165ms, avg_cost = 0.58x, quality_regressions = 0.9%
- compact-lite-int4: p95 = 420ms, p50 = 95ms, avg_cost = 0.42x, quality_regressions = 1.8% (mostly on codegen and some classify prompts)
Estimated hybrid routing effect (short->int4, mid->int8, long->fp16): effective p95 ~= 690ms, est cost delta = -46%.

Kai (Eng-runtime): Proposed Console route (paste into Route editor):
{
  "name": "zenmesh-tiered-routing",
  "rules": [
    {"if": "prompt_tokens <= 50", "route": "compact-lite-int4"},
    {"if": "prompt_tokens > 50 && prompt_tokens <= 150", "route": "compact-v2-int8"},
    {"else": "base-v3-fp16"}
  ],
  "canary": {"duration": "12h", "percent": 10},
  "monitoring": {"eval_set_id": "zenmesh-top4-2026-09-01", "alert_delta_pct": "0.7"}
}

healthbot: canary created zenmesh-int-handoff-8099999966

Omar (Solutions): Important note: codegen saw a visible delta on int4. Recommend per-endpoint overrides in the Route: set endpoint == 'codegen' -> base-v3-fp16. For classify endpoints, run a small confusion-matrix style eval and gate at 0.5% absolute delta.

Priya (CS-Mgr): Good. Please prepare a one-pager for the PM that includes: 1) estimated p95 improvement and sample A/B numbers, 2) expected cost savings, 3) quality caveats per endpoint, and 4) rollback gating rules. Also make the Console canary link visible to the customer PM during the renewal meeting. I want a 20m dry-run with the CSM on 2026-10-12 09:00 CET.

Maya (CS): I'll gather 30 representative customer prompts to add to the eval set (especially codegen examples). Also will draft the PM blurb: short bullets on expected wins and the plan if regressions appear.

Kai (Eng-runtime): Action items: run 8k full A/B (eta 6h), produce per-endpoint quality matrix, and upload perf graphs + route JSON to this thread. I'll also enable prefix KV cache for chat flows during the canary (KV usually trims p50 ~10-14%).

Omar (Solutions): I’ll run the focused codegen/classify eval and return a heatmap of tokens that show regressions (eta EOD). If regressions cluster on certain tokens, we can consider hybrid token-level fallback or a per-prompt override.

Priya (CS-Mgr): Thanks. If we can show a solid p95 improvement without material business-impacting regressions, this should materially reduce the renewal risk. Keep #renewals looped in for the PM meeting.
